paragraphs.0: We are BAFT. We don’t have an office you need to visit. We’re on the other side of the screen. 📲 BAFT is an online travel agency born from our experience living and working in Patagonia. We know the places, excursions and roads, as well as the little details you won’t always find in a brochure.
paragraphs.1: When you arrive somewhere new, you don’t always need to take the most famous excursion. Sometimes you want a quiet day; other times, an adventure. Or you simply have a free day and aren’t sure what to do.
